name: Groupe Quéguiner (holding)
note: Breton construction-materials group (SIREN 482611761, SAS, Landivisiau, founded 1948 by Yves Quéguiner) held by the Quéguiner family: Clément Quéguiner is Président de SAS of the holding and of Quéguiner Matériaux (SIREN 309540433), with Bertrand and Claude Quéguinaire as Directeurs Généraux; the third generation (Bertrand and Clément Quéguiner) joined in 2016. No state or fund stake found.
